[size=3][color=#d0e0e3]~ To Install (Replacer) ~
---------------------------------[/color]
[/size][/b][size=3]
    [color=#76a5af]- Install the latest version of SMAPI & [b]Content Patcher[/b]
    - Unzip & place the folder inside [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]
    - Run the game with SMAPI

[b][size=3][color=#d0e0e3]~ To Install (Standalone) ~
------------------------------------[/color]
[/size][/b][size=3]
    [color=#76a5af]- Install the latest version of SMAPI & [b]Custom Furniture[/b]
    - Unzip & place the folder inside [i]Stardew Valley/Mods/Custom Furniture/furniture[/i]
    - Run the game with SMAPI[/color][/size][/color]


[b][color=#d0e0e3]~ To Uninstall ~
----------------------[/color][/b]
    [color=#76a5af] - Remove folder from [i]Stardew Valley/Mods [/i]or[i] [/i][i]Stardew Valley/Mods/Custom Furniture/furniture[/i][/color]
[/size]
